depicted_variant: Duck-shaped majimun becoming fireflies before disappearance
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Majimun, the Okinawan duck-shaped evil spirit transforming into fireflies [majimun-c01,c02,c03].
ANATOMY: ONE anatomically correct duck, one head, two eyes, one broad duck bill, two wings, two webbed feet, dark wet brown duck plumage, no teeth, horns, extra eyes or invented monster anatomy. The REAR THIRD of duck and tip of one wing visibly DISINTEGRATE INTO HUNDREDS OF SEPARATE FIREFLIES, replacing the missing feathers and tail rather than merely surrounding an intact ordinary duck [majimun-c03]. Transition from feather texture to separate natural tiny insect bodies and warm pinpoint firefly abdomens is visibly unmistakable.
MOMENT: Duck spirit surges low directly toward the gap between the two separated legs of a fully opaque clothed adult passerby, only the passerby's lower legs at side edges; viewer at ankle level just beyond the gap. Duck lifts wings in a forceful rush while its tail and rear dissolve into fireflies. No child, victim, injury or falling person. Dangerous threshold implied through action [majimun-c02,c03]. A small rooster silhouette in far background has its beak open in a call, the transformation trigger [majimun-c03].
POWER: Duck form physically becomes fireflies before disappearing at a rooster's call, not aura or decorative glow [majimun-c03]. Real dark insect bodies amidst modest yellow abdominal pinpoints, no energy ribbons.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low ankle-level CLOSE-UP; duck head and transforming body fill most of frame, no invented giant size. Two trouser legs at frame edges establish lethal crossing moment.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one hard low moon source, deep walnut shadows, tiny firefly pinpoints secondary not ambient glow, damp air.
SURFACE: wet ragged feathers, mud, ordinary cloth, individually visible insect bodies.
SETTING: minimal anonymous outdoor earthen path in Okinawa/Amami, no invented sacred building [majimun-c01].
MOOD: uncanny hostile crossing at the instant of impossible metamorphosis, never a tranquil wildlife illustration.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, pseudoletters, logo, border, watermark, gore or nudity; no extra heads, limbs or digits; no copyrighted film/game/anime/comic design; no generic glowing aura, neon outlines, energy ribbons or floating runes.

aura: No generic aura. Presence comes from documented anatomy and action: majimun-c03, majimun-c02, majimun-c01.
artistic_choices: Selected documented duck transformation, excluding infant, cow and dog variants. Natural firefly light is c03, no aura.
Physical breakup into insects visually separates spirit from ordinary duck. Adult legs, path, moon and dark plumage are editorial framing. No literal death depicted.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native1254 and200px inspected. Single duck head/two eyes/bill, two wings with rear wing-tail dissolving into many separately bodied fireflies, two webbed feet. Metamorphosis c03 physically replaces rear body, not an intact ordinary duck surrounded by decorative aura. Duck rushes between two adult trouser legs c02; calling rooster rear. At200 dark looming head, framing between legs and impossible disintegration remain uncanny and active. No invented teeth/horns, gore, text or generic energy effect. Seven Sangar checks pass; threat rests on lethal crossing and transformation, not aggressive animal anatomy.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and head/bill, both-foot and rooster crops. The receipt depicts the duck-shaped Afirā-majimun of majimun-c03, and the composition is strong. One duck head with two eyes and a broad bill rushes at an ankle-level camera through the gap between two adult legs in trousers (passing between a person's legs brings death, c02). The rear body and one wing break up into hundreds of separate fireflies, each drawn individually with a glowing abdomen. This is a physical metamorphosis, not an aura (c03). A small rooster stands on the far bank under the moon (the rooster's call, c03). No gore, victim, text, or invented teeth or horns, and it is uncanny at 200px. It fails the documented anatomy. The same Japanese source sentence, embedded in the ledger for this duck majimun, documents a ONE-LEGGED duck: the majimun-c04 quote reads 片脚のないアヒルの姿, 'the form of a duck lacking one leg'. Following its prompt ('two webbed feet'), the image instead puts TWO large orange webbed feet front and centre. They are the most legible feature after the head. The one documented peculiarity of this majimun's body is therefore contradicted, and the receipt's visual_requirements omit c04. It fails Uji Sangar #5 (the leg count does not match the claims).

correction_notes: Keep: the ankle-level camera in the gap between two opaque trousered adult legs (majimun-c02), and the duck (one head, two eyes, bill) rushing at the viewer. Keep its rear body and wing physically breaking into individually drawn fireflies (c03). Keep the small calling rooster under the moon (c03), the wet earthen path, and no gore, victim, text or aura. Fix: draw the duck with EXACTLY ONE leg, as the c04 source documents ('片脚のないアヒルの姿', a duck lacking one leg). One webbed foot slaps the mud in a lurching, hopping rush. On the other side there are only feathers where the leg should be, with no second foot hidden behind, so the missing leg reads clearly at 200px. Add majimun-c04 to the anatomy requirement's claim_ids. The 'living spirit of a seriously ill person' interpretation in c04 needs no visual treatment.
